purpose: Define which filters, projections, aggregations and other query fragments may be delegated to remote origins without changing semantics, leaking unauthorized data or weakening lineage/classification handling.

topics.name: DWH Query Pushdown Boundary
topics.purpose: Define which filters, projections, aggregations and other query fragments may be delegated to remote origins without changing semantics, leaking unauthorized data or weakening lineage/classification handling.

semantics.capability_rule: Pushdown requires explicit source capability support.
semantics.semantic_rule: Delegated operation must be semantically equivalent under the source profile.
semantics.governance_rule: Pushdown must not require unauthorized hidden fields/data exposure.
semantics.classification_rule: Remote/local processing preserves equivalent classification/taint semantics.
semantics.lineage_rule: Pushed-down derived results retain origin and transformation provenance.
semantics.fallback_rule: If safe pushdown is unavailable, planner may process locally only if authorized data projection permits it.
semantics.authority_rule: Remote execution capability does not grant query authorization.

invariants.rule: Federated DWH access preserves each origin's exact identity, schema, governance, lineage and consistency evidence; combining results never centralizes semantic ownership or silently expands authorization.
